function scheduleTeleport(c, targetIdx): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/nav.ts:258

Arms the clone→real teleport: pendingTeleport is the normal path — the scroll spring's settle fires it through settleNav the frame the clone parks. The TELEPORT_DELAY timer is only the rAF-starvation watchdog (hidden tab): if the spring can't run, the instant jump still lands — invisible either way since clone and twin are pixel-identical. A pending teleport is cancelled first so rapid nav can't queue competing jumps.
